stories.title: POST /api/sessions/:id/messages — multi-provider LLM interview
stories.description:
Create `apps/api/src/services/llm.ts` — a provider-agnostic LLM service that supports both Anthropic and Ollama (RunPod) at runtime.

Provider selection: read `LLM_PROVIDER` env var (default 'anthropic'). Export:
```
export async function callLlm(system: string, messages: {role:'user'|'assistant', content:string}[]): Promise<string>
```

For Anthropic provider: use `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, model `claude-sonnet-4-6`, pass system + messages array.

For Ollama provider: use native `fetch` (no SDK needed), POST to `${OLLAMA_BASE_URL}/api/chat` with:
```json
{
  "model": "${OLLAMA_MODEL}",
  "stream": true,
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"<system>"}, ...messages],
  "options": {"num_ctx": 32768, "num_predict": OLLAMA_MAX_TOKENS, "temperature": 0.7}
}
```
Stream the NDJSON response line by line (each line is `{message:{content:string}, done:boolean}`), accumulate `message.content` chunks into the full response string. Use a reader+decoder loop identical to OOPs llm-call.ts. Throw an error if the fetch fails or the response is non-2xx.

Then add `POST /api/sessions/:id/messages` to the sessions router:
1. Load session + project from DB
2. Parse session.messages JSON
3. If user content is '__START__': skip adding user message, call callLlm with system prompt + empty messages (Claude opens the interview)
4. Otherwise: append user message, call callLlm with full history
5. Append assistant response to messages array
6. Save updated messages to DB
7. Call extractInterviewCompletion on response
8. If complete: set status='complete', summary=extracted, completedAt=now(), save, fire-and-forget synthesizePrd (stub that logs 'synthesis triggered' — real impl in P4-S1)
9. Return `{message:{role:'assistant',content:...}, sessionStatus:'active'|'complete'}`
acceptance_criteria: With LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic: POST /api/sessions/:id/messages returns an assistant message using Anthropic SDK
With LLM_PROVIDER=ollama and OLLAMA_BASE_URL set: the same route calls OLLAMA_BASE_URL/api/chat and streams the response
The session's messages array in DB grows by 2 (user + assistant) after each non-__START__ call
When the LLM returns [INTERVIEW_COMPLETE] in a response, session.status becomes 'complete' in DB
API returns `{message:{role:'assistant',...}, sessionStatus:'active'}` or `'complete'`
`npm run check` exits 0

stories.title: PRD synthesis service — rewrites PRD after each session (multi-provider)
stories.description:
Create `apps/api/src/services/prd-writer.ts`. Export `synthesizePrd(projectId: string): Promise<void>`. This function:
1. Loads the project + all completed sessions (where status='complete') from DB
2. Builds a synthesis user message: current prdMarkdown (or 'No PRD yet') + all session summaries
3. Calls `callLlm(system, messages)` from `./llm.ts` — this automatically uses whichever provider is configured (Anthropic or Ollama). System prompt instructs it to act as a PRD writer, incorporate session insights, maintain all four sections (Problem+Vision, Users+Personas, Features+Requirements, Tech+Constraints), and return a JSON object (no prose outside the JSON): `{markdown: string, ralphPrd: Phase[]}` where Phase matches ralph prd.json structure (id, name, status:'todo', stories with id/title/description/status:'todo'/acceptance_criteria)
4. Parses the JSON from the LLM response — strip markdown code fences if present (```json ... ``` wrapper)
5. Updates project.prdMarkdown and project.prdRalphJson (JSON.stringify(ralphPrd)) in DB
6. Wrapped in try/catch — this is called fire-and-forget and must not crash the process
acceptance_criteria: After a session completes (status='complete'), running `synthesizePrd(projectId)` updates project.prdMarkdown to non-empty string in DB
project.prdRalphJson becomes a valid JSON array of phase objects with stories
`curl -s http://localhost:4003/api/projects/<id> | jq .prdMarkdown` returns a non-empty PRD after synthesis
